title: 2D inviscid Boussinesq equations and 3D axisymmetric Euler equations: (1) A unification ($Em$), (2) Finite-time blow-up of two unified $(1+1)$D systems rigorously derived from ($Em$)
summary: We derive a unified polar $(1+2)$D subsystem $(Em)$, with $m=1,2$, from the 2D inviscid Boussinesq and 3D axisymmetric Euler equations. On the symmetry axes $θ=0,\pmπ/2,π$, ridge flatness closes the dynamics and gives two exact unified $(1+1)$D reductions: the horizontal-axis system $(R0)$ and the vertical-axis system $(Z0)$. Their common apex trace is a Constantin--Lax--Majda type ODE that yields finite-time blow-up at $x=0$.
